cond_0001.intro:
We are looking for a Regional FP&A Analyst to join our team.
The Regional FP&A Analyst, reporting to the VP Finance, is responsible for providing financial insights and analysis to senior management to support strategic decision-making. This includes financial performance analysis, management reporting, and developing budget/forecast tools for product streams and regions.
The role involves coordinating and managing the financial performance process across the region, ensuring results and implications are analyzed and explained to management. It also serves as a finance business partner to regional, commercial, and area leadership on growth, cost, and profitability initiatives, and provides forward-looking forecasts and reports that give management daily/weekly visibility on operational performance.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Duties and Responsibilities:
Manage and coordinate regional budget/forecasting processes, liaising with both regional/area leadership and group FP&A.
Draft the monthly regional management report for Regional VP Finance, ensuring key trends are explained, including opportunities, threats, and variances.
Prepare and present robust, comprehensive financial analysis for various business cases (cost management, new business, M&A).
Develop commercial and KPI performance tracking reports and analytics.
Contribute to global FP&A team analytics (revenue/profitability).
Lead the forecast and budget process coordinating with wider FP&A.
Support business initiatives (M&A, cost initiatives, new customers) working with Service Delivery (Operations), Sales, and Support functions.
Prepare financial models to support potential growth opportunities.
Work with Group FP&A and Financial Control to ensure robust reporting quality and data granularity.
Ensure forecasting accuracy by working with the FP&A team to develop robust processes on a sector and country basis.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Strong understanding of cashflow and working capital cycles.
Thorough understanding of accounting and financial planning principles.
Proficiency in financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Skilled in conducting financial analysis (trend and variance analysis, normalization, returns, NPV/IRR, integrated forecast financial statements).
Ability to explain complex financials to non-accounting functions.
Ability to work under pressure, balance multiple tasks, and across different time zones.
Ability to work in a multicultural environment.
Analytical and pragmatic approach with strong attention to detail.
Strong business partner and relationship-building capabilities across a diverse international group.
Highly proficient in Microsoft Office, including strong fluency with Excel formulas and functions.
3–5 Years' experience in a financial analyst role, preferably in a corporate or division/region FP&A team.
Corporate finance and accounting fundamentals, either through experience or qualification.
Experience working within complex international organizations.
Experience in data mining across platforms, data manipulation in Excel, and data interpretation.
Excellent work ethic with proven discretion and confidentiality.
Preferred Requirements:
Proficiency/ability to work with different GL, operating, and reporting systems.
Highly proficient in data visualization and automation platforms (Power BI, Cognos BI, etc.).
Bilingual English/Spanish written and verbal communication.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or recognized equivalent from an accredited university; equivalent experience may be substituted.
Experience working with Unit4 and Hyperion.
Experience designing and building reports with Power BI.
Experience in a service business.
Proven ability to manage projects effectively and achieve operational success.
Proven ability to drive financial analysis to support business optimization and forecasting accuracy.
Commercial finance background.

cond_0009.intro:
We are looking for a Regional FP&A Analyst to join our team.
The Regional FP&A Analyst reports to the VP Finance and works closely with regional, commercial, and area leadership to support financial performance analysis, management reporting, and budget/forecast development across product streams and regions.
cond_0009.responsibilities:
To help coordinate and manage the financial performance process across the region, ensuring results and implications are analyzed and shared with management. To provide robust financial analysis on the region's performance. Serve as a finance business partner to regional, commercial, and area leadership on various growth, cost, and profitability initiatives. Support a forward-looking view on the business by contributing to forecasts and developing reports that give management daily/weekly visibility on operational performance.
Duties and Responsibilities:
Coordinate regional budget/forecasting processes in close liaison with regional/area leadership and group FP&A.
Draft the monthly regional management report for Regional VP Finance, ensuring key trends, opportunities, threats, and variances are clearly explained.
Prepare and present comprehensive financial analysis for various business cases (cost management, new business, M&A).
Work with the team to develop commercial and KPI performance tracking reports and analytics.
Contribute to global FP&A team analytics (revenue/profitability).
Help coordinate the forecast and budget process together with the wider FP&A team.
Support business initiatives (M&A, cost initiatives, new customers) in collaboration with Service Delivery (Operations), Sales, and Support functions.
Prepare financial models to support potential growth opportunities.
Work alongside Group FP&A and Financial Control to help ensure robust reporting quality and data granularity.
Help ensure forecasting accuracy by working with the FP&A team to develop robust processes on a sector and country basis.
cond_0009.requirements:
Minimum Requirements:
Strong understanding of cashflow and working capital cycles.
Thorough understanding of accounting and financial planning principles.
Proficiency in financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Skilled in conducting financial analysis (trend and variance analysis, normalization, returns, NPV/IRR, integrated forecast financial statements).
Ability to explain complex financials to non-accounting functions.
Ability to work under pressure, balance multiple tasks, and across different time zones.
Ability to work in a multicultural environment.
Analytical and pragmatic approach with strong attention to detail.
Strong business partner and relationship-building capabilities across a diverse international group.
Highly proficient in Microsoft Office, including strong fluency with Excel formulas and functions.
3–5 Years' experience in a financial analyst role, preferably in a Corporate or division/region FP&A team.
Corporate finance and accounting fundamentals either through experience or qualification.
Experience working within complex international organizations.
Experience in data mining across platforms, data manipulation in Excel, and data interpretation.
Excellent work ethic and proven grounding in discretion and confidentiality.
Preferred Requirements:
Proficiency/ability to work with different GL, operating, and reporting systems.
Highly proficient in data visualization and automation platforms (Power BI, Cognos BI, etc.).
Bilingual English/Spanish written and verbal communication.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or recognized equivalent from an accredited university; equivalent experience may be substituted.
Experience working with Unit4 and Hyperion.
Experience designing and building reports with Power BI.
Experience in a service business.
Proven ability to manage projects effectively and achieve operational success.
Proven ability to support financial analysis for business optimization and forecasting accuracy.
Commercial finance background.

The Regional FP&A Analyst, reporting to the VP Finance, is responsible for providing financial insights and analysis to senior management to support strategic decision-making. This includes financial performance analysis, management reporting, and developing budget/forecast tools for product streams and regions.
The role involves coordinating and managing the financial performance process across the region, ensuring results and implications are analyzed and explained to management. It also serves as a finance business partner to regional, commercial, and area leadership on growth, cost, and profitability initiatives, and provides forward-looking forecasts and reports that give management daily/weekly visibility on operational performance.

The Regional FP&A Analyst reports to the VP Finance and plays a central role in providing financial insights and analysis to senior management to support strategic decision-making. The role is responsible for financial performance analysis and management reporting, as well as developing budget and forecast tools for product streams and regions.
A large part of this role involves staying in regular contact with regional, commercial, and area leadership as a finance business partner across growth, cost, and profitability initiatives. You will coordinate and manage the financial performance process across the region, actively communicating results and implications to management. You will also provide a forward-looking view on the business through forecasts and reports that give management daily and weekly visibility on operational performance.
cond_0267.responsibilities:
Manage and coordinate regional budget and forecasting processes, staying in close contact with both regional and area leadership and group FP&A.
Draft the monthly regional management report for Regional VP Finance, clearly explaining key trends, opportunities, threats, and variances.
Prepare and present comprehensive financial analysis for various business cases (cost management, new business, M&A), walking stakeholders through findings and handling questions.
Develop commercial and KPI performance tracking reports and analytics.
Actively contribute to global FP&A team analytics (revenue and profitability).
Lead the forecast and budget process, coordinating regularly with the wider FP&A team.
Support business initiatives (M&A, cost initiatives, new customers) by working closely with Service Delivery (Operations), Sales, and Support functions.
Prepare financial models to support potential growth opportunities.
Work with Group FP&A and Financial Control to ensure robust reporting quality and data granularity.
Ensure forecasting accuracy by working with the FP&A team to develop robust processes on a sector and country basis.
cond_0267.requirements:
Strong understanding of cashflow and working capital cycles.
Thorough understanding of accounting and financial planning principles.
Proficiency in financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
Excellent work ethic and proven grounding of discretion and confidentiality.
Skilled in conducting financial analysis (trend and variance analysis, normalization, returns, NPV/IRR, integrated forecast financial statements).
Proficiency and ability to work with different GL, operating, and reporting systems.
Highly proficient in data visualization and automation platforms (Power BI, Cognos BI, etc.).
Ability to explain complex financials clearly to non-accounting functions.
Ability to work under pressure, balance multiple tasks, and across different time zones.
Ability to work in a multicultural environment.
Analytical and pragmatic approach with strong attention to detail.
Strong business partnering and relationship-building capabilities across a diverse international group.
Highly proficient in Microsoft Office, including strong fluency with Excel formulas and functions.
Bilingual English/Spanish written and verbal communication preferred.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or recognized equivalent from an accredited university preferred; equivalent experience may be substituted.
3–5 Years' experience in a financial analyst role, preferably in a corporate or division/region FP&A team.
Corporate finance and accounting fundamentals either through experience or qualification.
Experience working within complex international organizations.
Experience working with Unit4 and Hyperion highly desirable.
Experience designing and building reports with Power BI a plus.
Experience in data mining across platforms, data manipulation in Excel, and data interpretation.
Experience in a service business beneficial.
Proven ability to manage projects effectively and achieve operational success.
Proven ability to drive financial analysis to support business optimization and forecasting accuracy.
Commercial finance background.
